notes: Hand-picked birds of Northeast India that the India trip does not have: the Brahmaputra grasslands and rivers (Kaziranga, Manas, Nameri, Pobitora, Dibru-Saikhowa), the hill forests of Arunachal Pradesh (Eaglenest, Sessa, Namdapha, Mishmi hills), Nagaland (Amur Falcon at Doyang), Meghalaya and Mizoram, and a few mangrove birds of the Sundarbans side. Ranked with GBIF/eBird counts for the whole of India (in/occurrence.csv) plus birding knowledge; vagrants, expedition-only birds and species with very few library photos are out (Naga Wren-Babbler, Chin Hills Wren-Babbler, Snowy-throated Babbler, Swamp Grass Babbler, Gould's Shortwing, Mrs Hume's Pheasant, Sclater's Monal and similar). Birds of Sikkim and Darjeeling are left to IN-HIMALAYA, but several eastern Himalayan hill-forest birds that are just as much Arunachal birds are kept here (laughingthrushes, minlas, sibias, parrotbills, forktails, Beautiful Nuthatch, Fire-tailed Myzornis, Kalij Pheasant, Great Barbet and others); settle duplicates centrally. Left out so that the pack stays near 130: Himalayan fulvettas, yuhinas, shrike-babblers, bullfinches and rosefinches, leaf warblers, most small flycatchers, Left to other packs or the country trip: Asian Openbill and River Lapwing (country trip), Indian Skimmer and Sind birds (IN-DESERT), White-bellied Treepie and Malabar birds (IN-WESTERNGHATS). Left out for lack of usable or trustworthy photos in the library (add back once reviewed): Black Bittern (blabit1), Mountain Hawk-Eagle (mouhae1), Rufous-bellied Eagle (rubeag2), White-naped Woodpecker (whnwoo1, mixed with flamebacks), Lesser Racket-tailed Drongo (lrtdro1, photos without rackets), Streaked Wren-Babbler (stwbab1) and Pygmy Cupwing (pywbab1, mixed cupwing photos). Left out for shaky photos or doubt after review: Gold-crested Myna (gocmyn1), Blyth's Paradise-Flycatcher (blypaf1), Slender-billed Oriole (slbori1), Large Woodshrike (larwoo1), Great Myna (whvmyn1), Black-throated Munia (bltmun1), Hodgson's Frogmouth (hodfro1), Great Eared-Nightjar (grenig1), Abbott's Babbler (abbbab1), Thick-billed Green-Pigeon (thbpig1) and White-bellied Treepie (whbtre1, a southern bird whose library photos show Collared Treepie). Shaky photo picks, to check on /trip-photos: Amur Falcon (ID rests on range, Red-footed Falcon look-alike), Collared Falconet (distant), Slender-billed Vulture, Lesser Coucal, Collared Owlet vs Asian Barred Owlet, Tawny Fish-Owl, Blossom-headed Parakeet, Pin-tailed Green-Pigeon, Pale-capped Pigeon, Golden-throated Barbet, Western Hooded Pitta (brown-crowned birds only), Grey-lored Broadbill, Brown Hornbill, Little Spiderhunter (photos look like Borneo birds), Orange-headed Thrush (mixed forms), Green Cochoa, Small Niltava, Golden-headed Cisticola, Jerdon's Babbler, Marsh Babbler, Crested Kingfisher, Watercock, Greater Necklaced Laughingthrush, Chestnut-crowned Laughingthrush, Long-tailed and Orange Minivets. White-throated Fantail has five approved photos only. Photos are picks from contact sheets of the unreviewed library, not approved on production: do not re-run trip_prep_media for IN-NORTHEAST or trip_prep_units.
